ns2:section.sectionText: MATH 115 ONL Preparation for Calculus PREREQUISITE: An ALEKS PPL math placement score of at least 65% with a test date of February 15, 2020 or later is required to be able to register for this course. There may be a 1 business day delay after earning the score before Self-Service allows registration. Those who have passed ALEKS PPL close to June 15 may wish to email mathadvising@illinois.edu with name, netid, and UIN to request an override to allow registration sooner. For more ALEKS PPL information please see http://math.illinois.edu/ALEKS .....LEARNING SYSTEM: The Summer Session section uses the ALEKS assessment and learning system. Students are required to purchase an ALEKS code to access the course online. The code is non-refundable and costs $60 for an 11-week code for Summer Session. ......PROCTORING: This course has a final exam that will be administered online via Respondus ......ALTERNATIVE REGISTRATION OPTION: A 16-week self-paced version of this class will also be available as part of the academic year term (not summer term). Registration for the self-paced class is done through https://netmath.illinois.edu/register/college (not Self-Service). The self-paced section has identical content and proctoring requirements, but students in the self-paced section are required to purchase an $81 non-refundable 18-week (1-semester) ALEKS code to access the course online.
